about: Story 3.24 (owner, 2026-11-25, Q1 and Q3): the golden run so far. workflow.yaml beside this file is the cut-down copy of the sample's report flow: the real flow with exactly the entries below taken out, each tagged with the story that restores it: a story of this epic after this one (stories.own) in its build order, not yet built. Put back alone, each entry is refused by agentic run at its step; a story that makes an entry runnable deletes or narrows it, edits workflow.yaml to match and moves both expected results in snapshot.txt in the same commit, so the list only shrinks; story 3.13 deletes the copy, this list and the drift test once the list is empty and the copy equals the real flow. The copy is a fixture only, never a template. Read by crates/am-e2e/tests/golden/, which spells none of these ids (AD-23).

removed_steps.why: a fan-out step (seats, max_parallel): with those keys removed it would have no seat, so no key removal can make it run
it runs on the Owner's seat, which has no model, and removing keys cannot give it gate: review (DR-137)
